sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000001-P1, was presented by PFIZER (the Supplier) to Prairie Pediatric Center 001 on October 5, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2.75%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Pneumococcal share floor of 85%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
